text:
anya: quick sync - Console is landing per-tenant quota buckets next week. New server headers: `x-quota-bucket: read-heavy|write-heavy` and `x-quota-reset-ms: 12000`. We need SDK guidance for propagation + client-side backoff.

luca: are those headers present on error responses only or all responses?

maria: server will add them on 429 and on 200 when near-threshold (for observability).

tony: typical patterns: 1) SDK forwards `x-quota-bucket` to Console/API when making downstream calls (so routing can tag logs), 2) SDK implements quota-aware backoff on 429 using `x-quota-reset-ms`.

anya: forwarding note: we currently strip unknown `x-` headers in the TS & Py libs. We'll need an opt-in pass-through.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch feat/quota-sdk (tests start) :gear: 

luca: for backoff behaviour, strongly prefer SDK not auto-retry streaming responses or single-shot websockets. For request/response (non-stream) we can do exponential backoff with `Retry-After` fallback to `x-quota-reset-ms`.

maria: telemetry request: expose a tag `sdk.quota_bucket` on all outgoing spans and a counter `sdk.quota_429_total{bucket=...}`. Console dashboard will join these to show which tenants are hitting which bucket.

kevin: propose SDK opt-in flag name: `enable_server_quota_backoff` default false. Also add `forward_server_quota_headers` default false. We'll flip defaults after 1-week canary.

olga: release process: Py/TS minor patches (no API surface change except optional flags) but Go will need a minor semver bump because of a new option struct field. Call it `WithServerQuotaBehavior`.

anya: questions: should SDKs surface the raw `x-quota-reset-ms` to callers in error objects? I think yes - helpful for app logic.

luca: yes return on error: `QuotaInfo{bucket: \"read-heavy\", reset_ms: 12000}` attached to 429 errors. Keep it small.

maria: dashboard panels I'll create: - timeseries: `sdk.quota_429_total` per-bucket - heatmap: percent of requests with `x-quota-bucket` header - table: tenants with most backoff events. I'll share link.

tony: keep an escape hatch: if SDK sees `x-quota-bucket: internal-protect`, do NOT forward it. Add a deny-list for sensitive buckets.

kevin: good call - add `quota_forward_denylist=[\"internal-protect\"]` to defaults.

ci-bot: build success feat/quota-sdk on ubuntu-latest (all checks passed) :white_check_mark:

anya: plan: 1) add opt-in flags in Py/TS/Go + error payloads with QuotaInfo (PRs by EOD), 2) Console canary will set headers for internal-dev tenants Wednesday 09:30 UTC, 3) monitor `sdk.quota_429_total` and `console.quota_applied` panels, 4) flip defaults after 7 days if no regressions.

olga: I'll draft release notes and the customer advisory: \"If your app relies on server-side quota hints to adapt behavior, enable the new SDK option or upgrade. Otherwise no change.\"

maria: reminder: add unit tests for header whitelist/denylist and a small integration test simulating 429+headers.

luca: small UX ask: TS client should allow pattern matching for forward list (e.g. `/^x-quota-/`) to avoid future flags for each header.

kevin: agreed. We'll add pattern support to all SDKs. Document in changelog.

anya: tagging ops: @infra please watch the canary. If we see customer-facing retries spike, revert rollback flag.

ci-bot: scheduled deployment: console/feature/quota-buckets -> canary internal-dev at 2026-03-25T09:30:00Z

anya: thanks everyone. follow-up sync Friday 11:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar_pad:
